question: Which cell organelle detoxifies toxins and drugs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Endoplasmic reticulum**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Endoplasmic reticulum** (ER) is the cell organelle responsible for detoxifying toxins and drugs.
 
• The ER is divided into two types: **rough ER** and **smooth ER**.
